aliases: True meaning infusion infusion of true meaning

summary.text: True meaning is comprehension of heaven and earth, Great Dao, and law fragments. Taking it in can raise a Gu Master's path realm far faster than ordinary accumulation.

claims.text: True meaning is the comprehension toward heaven and earth, Great Dao, and law fragments. When Reckless Savage Demon Venerable’s strength path and transformation path true meanings take earthly calamity form on the northern icy plain, shattering those forms releases the true meaning inside, and it enters the body of its own accord. Fairy Li Shan frames that intake as receiving teachings from the Demon Venerable: ordinary three qi fusion gives natural inspiration, while this true meaning is study under him.

The same stretch calls the intake true meaning infusion. Fang Yuan treats the calamity forms as external forms of true meaning: destroying them rapidly advances strength path realm that would otherwise need long accumulation for a qualitative jump. Infusion is compared to standing on a giant’s shoulder and reading the closed book of Great Dao at the pages one can already understand.

True meaning infusion is the same as taking in Reckless Savage Demon Venerable’s understanding toward cultivation. It directly increases foundation and can raise cultivation realm. Fang Yuan notes that slow, steady cultivation would need at least decades to reach the same stage without that rare opportunity.

After he finishes destroying the earthly calamity and taking in the infusion, his strength path stays grandmaster, transformation path rises to master, and flying rises from master to quasi-grandmaster.

Dream realm exploration can also yield true meaning. After Feng Jin Huang moves through Old Immortal Kong Jue’s dream, Fairy Bai Qing states that she unknowingly obtained some of his refinement path true meaning, because he was a refinement path supreme grandmaster.
Dream realms contain true meaning; once a Gu Immortal successfully explores a dream realm and obtains it, attainment level rises directly.

Historical records say that when strength path and transformation path Gu Masters undergo tribulation in the icy plain, they receive an infusion of Reckless Savage’s true meaning and grow in attainment. That gift is for Gu Masters ascending to immortal; after one becomes an immortal, calamities and tribulations happen in the immortal aperture, and ordinary tribulation there does not give that infusion. Fang Yuan later uses immortal tribulation tempering aperture so that tribulation beasts in the icy plain can still yield the infusion.

The infusion is like the guidance of Reckless Savage Demon Venerable with nothing withheld. Other than dream realms, only something like that infusion raises attainment so easily. Dream realms themselves are manifestations of emotions, obsessions, and desires, the remains of countless wills: successful exploration extracts true meaning from those scattered memories. In essence, that too is still true meaning infusion.

Too much of Reckless Savage’s true meaning can destroy consciousness, like a snake swallowing an elephant; Fang Yuan relies on wisdom path foundation and defensive wisdom path Immortal Gu to endure a huge intake.

It is not easy for a Gu Immortal to leave behind true meaning. Wisdom path and rule path have the greatest ease. Other paths must reach a certain level of mimicking those paths to leave true meaning behind, as with Long Hair Ancestor’s refinement path true meaning or Reckless Savage’s transformation path true meaning. No Gu Immortal can cultivate heaven path, so heaven path true meaning has never existed in that accounting.

Rule path and wisdom path Gu Immortals are more adept at extracting their own true meaning than other paths. When others take that true meaning, their corresponding attainment rises sharply, but the extractor’s attainment falls and the loss cannot be regained. That cost is why true meaning is so rare. Fairy Yu Xiu’s Endless Learning creates true meaning in the targets’ minds instead of expending the user’s true meaning; once created, it is absorbed and raises the relevant attainment, though the created true meaning still has limits set by the target’s aptitude, talent, comprehension, and personal experiences.
Attainment levels and path realm are covered on Attainment. Dream Realm covers exploration that yields this comprehension.
